paper_title: Ultralight Dark Matter Search with Space-Time Separated Atomic Clocks and Cavities
coupling_convention: |d_me| dimensionless (plot shows log10|d_me|; emitted values are 10^(plotted log value))
notes: Paper clearly constrains d_me alone (first such constraints) over 1e-19 to 2e-15 eV at 95% CL, using (i) NPL-PTB cavity-stabilized laser comparison over a 2220 km fiber link (sensitive to spatial DM field fluctuations, mass range up to 0.5 Hz -> 2e-15 eV) and (ii) GPS Rb satellite clocks vs ground H-maser (temporal/time-delay term, ~2.3e-5 Hz to ~1/60 Hz -> ~1e-19 to ~7e-17 eV). No numerical table is given; exclusion values appear only in Fig. 2 (log10|d_me| axis spanning -4 to 7). The emitted coupling values are ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE ESTIMATES reconstructed from the paper's signal formulas (mass-independent signal amplitude, kappa*phi0 with rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3, GPS D~26000 km, stated instabilities, stochastic factor xi~1/3): GPS limit ~1e4, cavity limit ~few x 1e5. Both limits are approximately flat in mass because the signal amplitude is mass-independent (phi0 ~ 1/m while phase delta ~ m). Downstream users should digitize Fig. 2 (available on AxionLimits) for precise values. Stochastic field correction (Centers et al.) included by authors.
